title: 'With artificial intelligence, we are summoning the demon' — quote of the day by Elon Musk on the rise…
excerpt: Scientists and technology execs alike are torn on what the implications of AI will be, although many liken it to a higher power
content_html:
With AI, the genie is out of the bottle, and there's no turning back. That's the overriding viewpoint across science and in Silicon Valley, where execs are increasingly building powerful systems. Beyond just building smarter machines, many among them have actually invoked quasi-religious imagery to describe the future.

Science and magic

SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk previously echoed science-fiction author Arthur C Clark when he likened scientific progress to magic.

Quote of the day

This article is part of TechRadar Pro's QOTD project to provide an insight into the minds of the brightest and most recognized figures in the technology industry today and in years gone by. Read the full series here.

In comments he made to students during an interview at the AeroAstro Centennial Symposium at MIT, Musk once again used colorful language to explain how he saw the progress we were making on AI.

In pursuing the goal of building advanced machine intelligence, beginning with AGI, he suggested there would be limited ways of controlling such an entity, and that any attempts to do so would be futile.

The following year after making these comments, alongside Sam Altman and other tech executives, Musk co-founded OpenAI, which spearheaded the release of ChatGPT and thrust modern AI systems into the mainstream.

The machine god

Musk's likening of AI to a demon has inherent connotations of danger or doom – which is appropriate, considering he and others have previously said AI is the biggest existential threat that humanity faces in the years to come.

For example, AI researchers Eliezer Yudkowsky and Nate Soares, published a book in 2025 called 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies' in which they laid out the case against building a superintelligent AI that could wipe us out.

These comparisons, however, are rejected by many others who see AI as unlikely to instigate science-fiction-type (or even supernatural-esque) doomsday scenarios. Chief among these voices is Jensen Huang, while just 3% of researchers say they were most worried about a scenario in which an out-of-contorl AI poses a threat to humanity.

Keumars Afifi-Sabet is a freelance contributor for Tech Radar and the Technology Editor for Live Science. He has written for a variety of publications including ITPro, The Week Digital and ComputerActive. He has worked as a technology journalist for more than five years, having previously held the role of features editor with ITPro. In his previous role, he oversaw the commissioning and publishing of long form in areas including AI, cyber security, cloud computing and digital transformation.

content_html_zh:
有了人工智能，精灵就从瓶子里出来了，而且没有回头路。 这是科学界和硅谷最重要的观点，高管们越来越多地构建强大的系统。 除了建造更智能的机器之外，其中许多机器实际上还引用了准宗教意象来描述未来。

科学与魔法

SpaceX 和特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 此前曾呼应科幻小说作家阿瑟·C·克拉克 (Arthur C Clark) 将科学进步比作魔法的说法。

当日报价

本文是 TechRadar Pro 的 QOTD 项目的一部分，旨在深入了解当今和过去几年技术行业中最聪明、最受认可的人物的想法。 在这里阅读完整系列。

在麻省理工学院 AeroAstro 百年纪念研讨会上接受采访时，马斯克再次用丰富多彩的语言解释了他如何看待我们在人工智能方面取得的进展。

在追求从通用人工智能（AGI）开始构建先进机器智能的目标时，他表示控制这种实体的方法是有限的，任何尝试都是徒劳的。

在发表这些评论后的第二年，马斯克与 Sam Altman 和其他科技高管共同创立了 OpenAI，该公司率先发布了 ChatGPT，并将现代人工智能系统推向主流。

机神

马斯克将人工智能比作恶魔，具有危险或厄运的内在含义——考虑到他和其他人此前曾表示人工智能是人类未来几年面临的最大生存威胁，这是恰当的。

例如，人工智能研究人员埃利泽·尤德科斯基 (Eliezer Yudkowsky) 和内特·苏亚雷斯 (Nate Soares) 在 2025 年出版了一本名为《如果有人建造它，每个人都会死》的书，他们在书中阐述了反对建造可能消灭我们的超级人工智能的理由。

然而，这些比较被许多其他人拒绝，他们认为人工智能不太可能引发科幻小说类型（甚至超自然类型）的世界末日场景。 这些声音中最主要的是黄仁勋，而只有 3% 的研究人员表示，他们最担心的是失控的人工智能对人类构成威胁。

Keumars Afifi-Sabet 是 Tech Radar 的自由撰稿人和 Live Science 的技术编辑。 他曾为多种出版物撰写文章，包括 ITPro、The Week Digital 和 ComputerActive。 他担任技术记者已有五年多，此前曾担任 ITPro 的专题编辑。 在之前的职位中，他负责监督人工智能、网络安全、云计算和数字化转型等领域的长篇文章的调试和发布。
